notes: Vendor invoice receipt header (logistics invoice verification), completing the purchasing cycle the same way customer_invoices_header completed the sales cycle -- no duplicate-table question here: the vendor side has exactly one invoice sheet, verified clean on FKs (0 null Vendor_ID, 0 null PO_ID, all PO references resolve against Purchase Orders). LIFNR uses the odd-series BP staging key (Vendor_ID x 2 + 1) matching vendors_core and the EKKO references. GJAHR (fiscal year, part of RBKP's key) is deliberately NOT emitted: deriving it requires fiscal-year-variant logic (a calendar year is an assumption), and posting date/year is assigned by the target system at invoice entry -- same reason BELNR elsewhere is only a staging key. Invoice Matching (3-way match log) is intentionally not mapped: matching is a runtime/config process in SAP (tolerance keys, ERS), and the match/variance amounts are derived comparisons, not migrated master or document data -- recorded in legacy_to_sap_mapping notes instead of a spec.

fields.sap_description: Document Number of an Invoice Document (staging key, matches RSEG lines)
Vendor (staging key, odd series Vendor_ID x 2 + 1)
Purchase Order Number (staging reference, resolves against EKKO)
Reference Document Number (external legacy/vendor invoice number)
Gross Invoice Value (tax-inclusive total -- RBKP stores the gross, unlike VBRK-NETWR which is net)

dropped_fields.reason: net total is derivable as gross minus tax; RBKP stores the gross invoice value (RMWWR) -- the tax-relevant code lives per line via RSEG-MWSKZ
tax is calculated per item via tax conditions (RSEG-MWSKZ), not stored on the header
AP clearing status is derived in SAP from outgoing payment/clearing documents (ACDOCA/BSEG against the invoice), not carried as a flat field -- same treatment as Amount_Collected on customer invoices
same as Amount_Paid -- derived open-item status, not stored
RBKP has no due-date field -- derived at runtime from the invoice date plus ZTERM payment terms from the vendor master (LFB1-ZTERM, already mapped)
structural in SAP -- invoice/parking/clearing status (RBKPP/RFBSK) is set by posting events, not carried from source; same treatment as every other Status column in this project

not_migrated_fields.reason: captured automatically as the entering SAP user
